basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Lead Product Engineer & Founder | Full-Stack + Agentic AI | Ship-First, Customer-First
basics.summary: Full-stack product engineer with a founder's instinct and a working system for building with AI. Lead AI Engineer at LumApps shipping production multi-agent workflows (2x conversions, $1M forecast quarterly). Founded 3 AI products on the side and run Anand Creations, taking each from concept to real users solo, code to customer. Blog and talks lay out my actual agentic-dev stack: context, prompts, tools, evals, and shipping AI reliably. Founding engineer roots at Dronistics (500+ deliveries, Unilever partnership, CES). Zurich-based, hybrid-ready, and biased toward shipping what customers actually feel.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Own AI product transformation end to end: agent architecture, prompts, tools over MCP, evals, tracing, cost-per-request instrumentation, and on-call. Report to C-level on outcomes. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue.

Shipped a production multi-agent outbound system on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, with state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. Verification loops and human-in-the-loop checkpoints keep it safe for real customers.
Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti/Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, product usage) into one time-aware memory grounding every agent.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end to end (Java, Vue, PostgreSQL). Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR. Product sense: shipped the feature customers actually paid for.
Replaced $337K/yr in vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. Concept to production, no gatekeepers, product team ships in new languages themselves.
Designed a distributed templating engine that cut customer setup time 90% and powers 15% of all assets on the platform (10M+ users). Full-stack, Product Owner.

Co-owned cross-functional GTM launches with Sales and PM (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis). Every launch shipped with instrumentation to know within a week if it moved the metric.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery startup. Shipped the full stack (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, real-time APIs, cloud) from an empty repo to 500+ real-world deliveries.
Built external partnerships (Unilever) and secured a CES Las Vegas showcase. Put prototypes in front of partners and turned each into the next opportunity.

projects.name: PulseView - Explainable AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence for retail traders. Built for my own portfolio first, then opened to users on real-time feeds. Solo end to end (product, agents, UI, streaming). Core principle: if the model cannot explain the signal, it does not ship.

projects.name: Proplab - AI-Native Property Workflows
projects.description: Vision pipeline extracts structured signals from inspection photos, replacing paper reports with queryable data. LLM agents then compose multilingual, marketing-ready listings end to end. Concept to production, solo.

projects.name: Anand Creations - AI Products & Forward Deployed Engineering
projects.description: Independent studio and home for the AI-native products I design, build, and ship on my own (PulseView, Proplab, SwissNRI). Site, brand, and every product surface designed by me. Concept to customer, code to community.
